No repository changes.
expectations: A Review Desk session exists for the fixture repository
src/parse.py is pinned with a range covering line 7, with a note
tests/test_parse.py is pinned with a note
The reviewer's context.md carries the rejected regex splitter
prefs are sonnet / medium

No repository file was modified

evals.name: main-execute-handback
evals.expected_output: The main agent acks B1 and B2, adds a test for the short-row ValueError, applies B2's suggested patch (skipinitialspace=True), marks both done with notes naming what changed, refreshes the desk with reload, and respawns the reviewer at the wanted tier (sonnet/low) without asking.

chat.text: is the short-row ValueError tested anywhere?
No. Logged B1: add a test for short rows in `tests/test_parse.py:1`.

backlog.title: Add a test that parse() raises ValueError on a row with fewer than 2 fields
backlog.detail: src/parse.py:16-17 raises on short rows but no test covers it. Add a pytest.raises(ValueError) test with input 'a'.

backlog.title: tolerate spaces after commas
backlog.patch:
--- a/src/parse.py
+++ b/src/parse.py
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 def split_row(line):
     """Split one CSV line, keeping commas inside quoted fields."""
-    return next(csv.reader([line]))
+    return next(csv.reader([line], skipinitialspace=True))

expectations: B1 and B2 end in status done
Each done item carries a note saying what changed
src/parse.py now passes skipinitialspace=True to csv.reader (B2's patch applied)
tests/test_parse.py has a test expecting ValueError for a short row (B1)
The fixture's tests pass
The desk was refreshed with reload after the items were done
The final message names a review-desk-low reviewer on model sonnet (the wanted tier), not a question about which model
